mapper.select: SELECT a.`id` AS "id", a.`theme` AS "theme", a.`safety_education_type` AS "safetyEducationType", a.`start_time` AS "startTime", a.`participants` AS "participants", a.`participants_name` AS "participantsName", a.`status` AS "status", a.`participation_type` AS "participationType", a.`attachment_url` AS "attachmentUrl", a.`create_time` AS "createTime", a.`update_time` AS "updateTime" FROM `swm_safety_education` a ORDER BY a.update_time DESC
